first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation, while avoiding the margin and customer-quality risks of reacting immediately with promotional pricing. Verify the two onboarding-related records and the pricing alternative, especially for evidence on qualified revenue, retention, and segment effects before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding, prioritizing the confirmed flow from memory_86: it directly addresses the 4% completion decline and previously improved completion by 13%, time-to-value by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention by 3%. Signup simplification supports potential SMB activation and qualified-revenue gains, but its segment limitation and slight retention decline argue against a broad rollout. Promotional pricing is rejected despite acquisition lift because the verified cohort had 12% lower retention and failed to survive first renewal, conflicting with sustainable qualified revenue.
